checkpoints.description: [1/2] Cache the immutable check portion of judge cache keys

impact_assessment.benefits: Remove repeated check serialization while preserving key identity and all cache verdicts
impact_assessment.mitigation: failing-first check-serialization counter test, full judge cache suite, real stored-answer verdict hash and strict gates; revert on any cache or verdict change
impact_assessment.risks: contract: no key collisions and text/check/timeout identity semantics; dependency: WeakMap; concurrency: process-local cache; state: existing judge caches only
impact_assessment.why: Key construction serializes the full check for every answer even when the same check object is used across hundreds of texts; a 20,000-call prototype improved 9.881ms to 2.542ms

measurements.workload: 20,000 key calls using 200 real suite checks, alternating old/new per round

impact_assessment.benefits: Rebuild the id and filename index only when the public model list changes, preserving exact first-match precedence
impact_assessment.mitigation: failing-first index-build test, duplicate-key precedence assertions, openai/server suites, benchmark and strict gates; revert on any lookup difference
impact_assessment.risks: contract: id lookups win over filename lookups and first list match wins for duplicate keys; dependency: listPublicRebuilds version; concurrency: process-local WeakMap; state: cache must invalidate on registry changes

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Add a short TTL to the listProfiles per-file stat pass

impact_assessment.benefits: Skip unchanged stat passes for up to one second while still detecting added/removed files on every call and writes through saveProfile immediately
impact_assessment.mitigation: failing-first stat-count test, add/remove and save invalidation tests, 60-profile benchmark, server/profile suites and strict gates; revert on any summary change
impact_assessment.risks: contract: returned summaries, copy semantics, stamp reuse and ENOENT unchanged; dependency: Date.now only; concurrency: process-local cache; state: stale mtime/size edits tolerated for the TTL window but saves invalidate
impact_assessment.why: Profile list polls repeat the same 12 stats every 2 seconds even though the parsed summaries are already cached; registry uses a short TTL for the same directory-stamp pattern
